title.zh: Federated Hermes joins Wall Street's tokenization push with plans for first onchain fund shares
title.en: Federated Hermes joins Wall Street's tokenization push with plans for first onchain fund shares

current_state.zh: Federated Hermes, a $911 billion asset manager, plans to issue its first tokenized fund share classes in early 2027 through a partnership with regulated brokerage and custody provider Prometheum, bringing blockchain-based shares into traditional brokerage accounts.
current_state.en: Federated Hermes, a $911 billion asset manager, plans to issue its first tokenized fund share classes in early 2027 through a partnership with regulated brokerage and custody provider Prometheum, bringing blockchain-based shares into traditional brokerage accounts.
